stem: Water ____ at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
explanation: Genel doğru (bilimsel gerçek) Present Simple ile verilir: boils.

stem: Scientists ____ a new vaccine at the moment, and they expect results next year.
explanation: 'At the moment' süren eylemi gösterir: Present Continuous (are developing).

stem: I ____ that this solution is the best one available.
explanation: Believe bir durum (stative) fiilidir; sürekli yapıda kullanılmaz: believe.

stem: The company ____ its profits twice since it moved to the new market.
explanation: Since + geçmiş zaman → ana cümlede Present Perfect: has doubled.

stem: The treaty ____ in 1998 after months of negotiation.
explanation: 'In 1998' belirli geçmiş zaman ifadesi; Present Perfect kullanılamaz. Özne antlaşma olduğu için pasif: was signed.

stem: It is the first time that she ____ a presentation in English.
explanation: 'It is the first time' kalıbından sonra Present Perfect gelir: has given.

stem: Prices ____ steadily since the beginning of the year.
explanation: Since ile sürekli bir değişim vurgulanıyor: have been rising.

stem: How long ____ for this company?
explanation: 'How long' süre sorusudur; süregelen eylem için Present Perfect Continuous kullanılır.

stem: I ____ this man for ten years, and I have never seen him lose his temper.
explanation: Know durum fiilidir; -ing'li perfect yapısı kullanılmaz: have known.

stem: By the time the rescue team arrived, the climbers ____ trapped for two days.
explanation: By the time + Past Simple → ana cümlede Past Perfect: had been.

stem: Hardly ____ the office when the phone rang.
explanation: Hardly başta olduğu için devrik yapı gelir ve ilk kısım Past Perfect olur: Hardly had she left ... when.

stem: By the time we reached the station, the train ____.
explanation: By the time + Past Simple → önce gerçekleşen eylem Past Perfect: had left.

stem: By 2035, scientists ____ a cure for the disease.
explanation: 'By + gelecekteki yıl' → Future Perfect: will have found.

stem: This time next week, we ____ on a beach in Spain.
explanation: 'This time next week' gelecekte belirli bir anda süren eylemi gösterir: Future Continuous.

stem: Please inform me as soon as the results ____ available.
explanation: As soon as sonrasında gelecek için Present Simple kullanılır: are.

stem: I will tell him the news when he ____ tomorrow.
explanation: When zaman bağlacından sonra will kullanılmaz: comes.

stem: I wonder when the manager ____ back from the conference.
explanation: When burada dolaylı soru sözcüğüdür (zaman bağlacı değil); gelecek için will kullanılır: will come.

stem: If the weather ____ bad tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
explanation: Ana cümlede will var (1. tip). If cümlesinde will kullanılmaz: is.

stem: The new regulations ____ last year.
explanation: Özne düzenlemelerdir ve eylemi yapan belli değil; geçmiş zaman → were introduced.

stem: The accident ____ at around 3 a.m.
explanation: Happen geçişsiz bir fiildir; passive yapılmaz: happened.

stem: The bridge ____ at the moment, so drivers must use the alternative route.
explanation: Köprü eylemi yapamaz → passive; 'at the moment' → sürekli: is being repaired.

stem: He is said ____ the country before the investigation began.
explanation: Söyleme şimdi, olay daha önce: is said to have left.

stem: We had our house ____ last month.
explanation: Causative: have + nesne + V3 (yaptırmak): painted.

stem: The old building needs ____ before the winter.
explanation: Need + V-ing = need to be V3 (pasif anlam): needs renovating.

stem: If the company ____ earlier, it would have avoided the crisis.
explanation: Ana cümlede would have avoided (3. tip) var: If + had V3.

stem: If I ____ you, I would reconsider the offer.
explanation: 2. tip koşul: If + V2 (were), would + V1.

stem: If he had studied harder at university, he ____ a better job now.
explanation: Karma tip: geçmişteki sebep (had studied), şimdiki sonuç (now): would have.

stem: I wish I ____ the answer, but I have no idea.
explanation: Şimdiki zamanla ilgili dilek: wish + V2 (knew).

stem: She regrets not accepting the job. She wishes she ____ it.
explanation: Geçmişle ilgili pişmanlık: wish + had V3.

stem: It is high time the government ____ action against pollution.
explanation: It is (high) time + özne + Past Simple: took.

stem: The committee recommended that the proposal ____ rejected.
explanation: Recommend + that + özne + (should) V1: be rejected.

stem: It is essential that every employee ____ the safety training.
explanation: It is essential that + özne + (should) V1: attend.

stem: The doctor insisted that the patient ____ complete rest.
explanation: Insist (ısrar / zorunluluk anlamında) + that + özne + V1: have.

stem: You ____ wear a seat belt; it is the law.
explanation: Yasal zorunluluk: must.

stem: She ____ be at home. I saw her car outside the house.
explanation: Kanıta dayalı güçlü çıkarım: must be.

stem: You ____ pay to enter the museum; it is free.
explanation: Zorunlu değil anlamı: don't have to. Mustn't yasak anlamı taşır.

stem: The streets are wet. It ____ during the night.
explanation: Geçmişle ilgili güçlü çıkarım: must have V3.

stem: He ____ the report yesterday; he was on holiday.
explanation: Geçmişle ilgili imkânsızlık: can't have V3.

stem: You ____ me earlier; I could have helped you.
explanation: Yapılmayan şey için pişmanlık / eleştiri: should have V3.

stem: The manager avoided ____ the journalists' questions.
explanation: Avoid + V-ing.

stem: She decided ____ the meeting until next week.
explanation: Decide + to V1.

stem: We are looking forward to ____ from you.
explanation: Look forward to kalıbındaki to edattır; V-ing gelir: hearing.

stem: ____ the report carefully, the manager approved the budget.
explanation: Özne (the manager) eylemi yapıyor ve önce tamamlanan eylem: Having read.

stem: ____ in 1923, the university is one of the oldest in the country.
explanation: Üniversite kurulandır (pasif anlam): Founded.

stem: ____ down the street, Anna was almost hit by a cyclist.
explanation: Yürüyen Anna'dır (özne eylemi yapıyor): Walking.

stem: We had the contract ____ by a lawyer.
explanation: Have + nesne + V3: işi başkasına yaptırmak.

stem: The teacher made the students ____ the essay.
explanation: Make + kişi + V1 (to yok).

stem: She got her brother ____ her car.
explanation: Get + kişi + to V1.

stem: The scientist ____ research won the prize works at Oxford.
explanation: İyelik (araştırması) bildirildiği için whose gerekir.

stem: The city in ____ she was born has changed a lot.
explanation: Edat + which: in which (edatın ardından that gelmez; where de yanına edat almaz).

stem: He passed the exam, ____ surprised everyone.
explanation: Virgülden sonra önceki cümlenin tamamına gönderme yapan which gelir; that kullanılmaz.

stem: The people ____ outside the building were asked to leave.
explanation: Kısaltılmış relative clause: people who were waiting → waiting.

stem: The books ____ last year are now out of print.
explanation: Kitaplar yayımlanandır (pasif): books (which were) published → published.

stem: She was the first woman ____ the prize.
explanation: The first / last / only + isim + to V1: to win.

stem: I wonder where ____ yesterday.
explanation: Dolaylı soruda düz cümle sırası kullanılır: where he went.

stem: It remains unclear ____ the new policy will work.
explanation: 'Belirsiz olan, politikanın işe yarayıp yaramayacağıdır': whether.

stem: ____ the committee decided has not been announced yet.
explanation: Cümlede 'decided' fiilinin nesnesi eksik; bu eksikliği what tamamlar: What the committee decided.

stem: Rarely ____ students realise how much sleep affects their performance.
explanation: Rarely başta olduğu için yardımcı fiil özneden önce gelir; özne çoğul: do students realise.

stem: Not until the final report was published ____ the public learn the truth.
explanation: Not until ... + devrik ana cümle: did the public learn.

stem: No sooner ____ the building than the alarm went off.
explanation: No sooner + had + özne + V3 ... than + Past Simple.

stem: It was in 1999 ____ the company went public.
explanation: Cleft cümle: It was + vurgulanan öğe + that.

stem: ____ I need most is more time.
explanation: What I need = ihtiyacım olan şey (pseudo-cleft): What I need most is ...

stem: It was not until midnight ____ the fire was brought under control.
explanation: It was not until ... that ... kalıbı.

stem: The number of students who study abroad ____ increased dramatically.
explanation: The number of + çoğul isim → tekil fiil: has increased.

stem: A number of experts ____ criticised the policy.
explanation: A number of + çoğul isim → çoğul fiil: have criticised.

stem: Economics ____ the study of how societies use scarce resources.
explanation: Economics (bilim dalı adı) tekil sayılır: is.

stem: The campaign failed because ____ people were aware of the risks involved.
explanation: Başarısızlığın nedeni olumsuz anlamdır (yeterli kişi yok): few.

stem: Unfortunately, ____ progress has been made in the negotiations.
explanation: Progress sayılamazdır ve olumsuz anlam isteniyor: little.

stem: There are two proposals; ____ of them is acceptable to the unions.
explanation: İki seçenekten hiçbiri: neither; 'is' tekil fiildir.

stem: The population of Istanbul is far larger than ____ of Ankara.
explanation: Karşılaştırmada ikinci isim yerine that of (the population) kullanılır.

stem: The ____ you practise, the better you become.
explanation: The + comparative, the + comparative: The more ..., the better ...

stem: This laptop is ____ more expensive than the older model.
explanation: Comparative'i far / much / even güçlendirir; very ve so güçlendirmez.

stem: She is ____ unique talent in the field of music.
explanation: Unique 'yu' sesiyle başladığı için a kullanılır: a unique.

stem: Information is ____ power.
explanation: Sayılamaz isim genel anlamda kullanılırken article almaz.

stem: She is ____ honest person who always tells the truth.
explanation: Honest sesli harfle (o) başladığı için an kullanılır.

stem: The two companies have helped ____ for many years.
explanation: İki taraf birbirine yardım ediyor: each other.

stem: The climate of Spain is warmer than ____ of Britain.
explanation: Climate tekil ve sayılamaz; karşılaştırmada that of.

stem: I don't like this phone; I prefer the red ____.
explanation: Tekil sayılabilir isim (phone) yerine one.

stem: Most of the cases were dependent ____ the testimony of one witness.
explanation: Be dependent on.

stem: The new regulations are expected to result ____ a significant reduction in costs.
explanation: Result in (sonuç doğurmak) ↔ result from (-den kaynaklanmak).

stem: The committee spent an hour ____ the budget proposal.
explanation: Discuss doğrudan nesne alır; edat gelmez.

stem: She enjoys reading novels, hiking in the mountains, and ____.
explanation: Liste paralel olmalı: reading, hiking, swimming (V-ing).

stem: The new system is not only faster but also ____.
explanation: Not only ... but also yapısında iki yan paralel olmalı: faster (sıfat) – more economical (sıfat).

stem: The policy aims to reduce costs, to improve quality, and ____ customer satisfaction.
explanation: Liste paralel olmalı: to reduce, to improve, to increase.

stem: The food at that restaurant tastes ____.
explanation: Taste bağlayıcı fiildir; sonrasında sıfat gelir: good.

stem: She works very ____ to finish the project on time.
explanation: Hard hem sıfat hem zarftır; hardly neredeyse hiç anlamındadır: works hard.

stem: The task was ____ difficult for the beginners to complete.
explanation: Too + sıfat + for + kişi + to V1: gereğinden fazla zor.

stem: He said that he ____ tired and wanted to go home.
explanation: Ana fiil geçmiş (said) → yan cümle bir zaman geri gider: was.

stem: The teacher asked the students where ____.
explanation: Dolaylı soruda düz cümle sırası ve zaman kayması: they lived.

stem: She denied ____ the confidential documents.
explanation: Deny + V-ing.

stem: I am used to ____ up early.
explanation: Be used to + V-ing (alışkın olmak).

stem: You ____ better see a doctor about that cough.
explanation: Had better + V1.

stem: It was kind ____ you to lend me the money.
explanation: Kişinin karakterini bildiren sıfatlardan sonra of kullanılır: It was kind of you.

stem: The manager, together with his assistants, ____ the project's progress every week.
explanation: Together with araya girse de özne tekil (the manager); 'every week' → Present Simple: reviews.

stem: The more carefully the samples ____, the more reliable the results will be.
explanation: Samples çoğul ve eylemi yapan değil, yapılan; the more ... passive: are examined.

stem: Few people can afford ____ a house in the city centre these days.
explanation: Afford + to V1.

stem: ____ prices rose sharply, demand remained strong.
explanation: Boşluktan sonra tam cümle var → bağlaç: Although.

stem: ____ the rise in prices, demand remained strong.
explanation: Boşluktan sonra isim grubu var → edat: Despite.

stem: Prices rose sharply; ____, demand remained strong.
explanation: Noktalı virgülden sonra virgülle ayrılan cümleler arası zarf gerekir: however.
